title: Biomanufacturing Process Optimization
tagline: A reproducible, cost-aware bioprocess that translates onto industrially representative equipment
blurb: Growth Curve develops and refines the bioprocess itself (media and feed strategy, fermentation parameters, and downstream recovery), driving titer, yield, and batch-to-batch consistency up while pulling cost of goods down. Every change is measured against a defined analytical baseline and chosen to translate onto larger equipment.
bullet_points: Recursive by design: iterative design-build-test loops tune the process and the strain against quantitative targets until the data says the program is ready.
Fully instrumented bioreactors: benchtop vessels controlling temperature, pH, DO, and feed, with at-line and in-line monitoring and design-of-experiments workflows.
Precision where it counts: gravimetric feeding for critical carbon sources and inducers measures what actually reaches the vessel, not what a pump totalizer assumes.
Downstream included: centrifugation, filtration, chromatography, and drying developed alongside the upstream process.
Deliverables: a defined process with control ranges, a titer, yield, and cost-of-goods model, batch records, and a scale-up risk assessment.

context_items.blurb: Former tier-one military personnel, intelligence operatives, and serial entrepreneurs, proven in war zones, intelligence operations, and the private sector.

title: Leadership Strategy
tagline: A trusted extension of leadership
blurb: Supporting founders and leadership teams in decision-making, alignment, and execution oversight, especially during periods of complexity, growth, and change. Fountain City Partners operates alongside leadership, not above it.
bullet_points: Strategic planning and prioritization: turning a long list of good ideas into a short list of what matters now, with owners and deadlines.
Leadership alignment: the leadership team working from the same definitions, priorities, and expectations.
Organizational structure: every role defined and every decision assigned, so accountability is designed in rather than hoped for.
Accountability systems: the cadence, metrics, and follow-through that make sure what gets decided actually gets done.
Interim executive support: an experienced operator in the seat while the business searches, transitions, or scales into a permanent hire.

title: Accounting
tagline: Clean books, reliable controls
blurb: Maintaining accurate financial records and the control infrastructure leadership depends on. Clean books and reliable reporting are the foundation every other decision is built on.
bullet_points: Chart of accounts and coding: a structure that reflects how the business actually operates, so the numbers mean something.
Payables, receivables, expenses, and payroll: the day-to-day transactions handled accurately and on time.
GAAP-compliant close and reporting: a disciplined, repeatable close that produces statements leadership, lenders, and investors can trust.
Internal controls and audit readiness: controls designed in advance, so an audit is a formality instead of a fire drill.

title: Finance
tagline: Financial visibility that drives decisions
blurb: Helping leadership understand, forecast, and manage business performance. Fountain City Partners connects operational activity to financial visibility so decisions are grounded in reality.
bullet_points: Forecasting, planning, and budgeting: forward-looking models tied to the operational drivers that actually move the numbers.
Cash management: visibility into cash needs before they become cash problems.
Financial reporting: clear, consistent performance reporting built for the people who have to act on it.
Compensation structure: pay and incentive plans designed around the outcomes the business needs.
Board and investor reporting: investor-grade reporting that builds confidence with the people backing the business.

title: Operations
tagline: How work moves through the business
blurb: Designing and improving how work moves through the organization. Fountain City Partners helps teams operate more consistently, efficiently, and predictably across every function.
bullet_points: Process design and standardization: one documented way to do the work, so outcomes stop depending on who happens to do it.
Workflow optimization: removing the hand-offs, duplication, and delays that slow work down between teams.
Operating cadence and governance: meeting structures and review rhythms that keep priorities visible and decisions moving.
Cross-functional coordination: teams aligned around shared goals instead of competing ones.
Capacity planning: constraints seen coming before they turn into missed commitments.

title: Custom Systems
tagline: Every role, decision, and workflow defined, visible, and connected
blurb: Building the systems and data infrastructure that support scalable operations. Fountain City Partners documents how the business runs, implements and integrates the right software, and structures the data underneath it, because AI is only as good as the system it runs on.
bullet_points: Documentation and SOPs: how the business actually runs, written down, so it can be taught, measured, and improved.
Software implementations: new tools configured around defined processes, not the other way around.
Systems integration: the software already in use connected, so data flows between systems instead of being re-keyed.
Data structuring and governance: consistent definitions, clear ownership, and controlled access across the organization's data.
AI foundations: the structured data and clear processes that let automation and AI deliver real results.

title: Custom Software
tagline: Built for how the business actually runs
blurb: When off-the-shelf tools don't fit, Fountain City Partners builds software around the organization's own processes and data. Every build starts from a defined system, so the software reinforces how the business should run rather than hard-coding how it happens to run today.
bullet_points: System first, software second: processes and data are defined before a line of code is written.
Fits the existing stack: custom tools integrate with the systems already in place instead of adding another silo.
Automation where it compounds: repetitive, rules-based work moved out of spreadsheets and inboxes and into software.
Built by operators: designed by people who work inside the finance, operations, and technology environments the software supports.

title: Transactions
tagline: Operational truth before, during, and after the deal
blurb: Supporting businesses, investors, and boards through transactions and organizational change. Fountain City Partners helps leadership teams prepare for, execute, and integrate major business events, and helps investors see what's really happening inside the businesses they back.
bullet_points: Transaction readiness: the books, systems, and structure a buyer or investor expects, in place before the process starts.
Pre-transaction diligence: quality of earnings plus operational, process, systems, and organizational assessments that go beyond presentations and surface-level reporting.
Post-close integration: operating model design, finance and reporting infrastructure, and systems integration that help the business perform after the deal closes.
Oversight and advisory: performance monitoring, board participation, and early identification of operational risk.

Experience from inside the process: the team has bootstrapped companies, raised outside capital, completed acquisitions, and gone through diligence themselves, so they know what diligence captures and what it misses.
